newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Distrigaz says cold snap boosting sales.
newsitem.headline: Distrigaz says cold snap boosting sales.

text.p: Distrigaz, a Belgian natural gas distribution company, on Friday said Europe's cold snap had sent gas sales soaring to record levels.

"In December we sold 13 percent more natural gas than we would under normal atmospheric conditions," the company said in a statement. Additional demand had been met through existing underground stocks.

On January 2, consumption totaled 3,150 terrajoules, surpassing the 2,910 TJ consumed on December 31. The previous all-time high for daily consumption was 2,833 TJ, set on January 25, 1996, Distrigaz added.
